definitions.explanation: Washing or cleaning with water, especially referring to flush toilets or water-based cleaning systems.

notes:
Compound of {水|すい} (water) + {洗|せん} (wash). Means cleaning or flushing with water, most commonly in the context of toilets.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水洗|すいせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水洗|すいせん}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧: flush toilet
- {水洗|すいせん}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: converting to flush/water systems
- {水洗|すいせん}{式|しき}: flush type, water-wash style
- {水洗|すいせん}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: washable (with water)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{水洗|すいせん}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ contrasts with ⟦{汲|く}み{取|と}り→汲み取る：25269_kumitoru⟧{式|しき}⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ (pit-style toilet), which is still found in older buildings and rural areas.

WATCH OUT:
Be aware of the common homophones ⟦{推薦|すいせん}→推薦：03358_suisen⟧ (recommendation) and ⟦{水仙|すいせん}→水仙：27427_suisen⟧ (narcissus/daffodil). Context and kanji make the meaning clear in writing.
